scope.dialog: ConnectionModalSheet opened from the configuration source flow into the remote subscription form
scope.sharedImplementation: Global bottom-sheet scrim, entrance/exit translation, and floating-form presentation
excluded: Material3 AlertDialog internals and call sites
Performance results under a running proxy core

source.change: Read presentation progress during draw/layer updates instead of feeding every frame through sheet layout and form recomposition; keep keyboard, detents, touch, duration and submit semantics unchanged.

deviceRegression.assertions: All expected screens remained reachable in each round; no crash, stuck dialog, submit, profile import, or configuration mutation.
deviceRegression.measurementLimit: gfxinfo used shell-driven taps and a 1.2s observation window; small medians are directional only and do not establish stable app-wide jank improvement.

perfetto.window: 500ms from the first MainActivity frame for each dialog transition
perfetto.traceIntegrity: Perfetto stats contained zero traced buffer discard and zero positive error/data_loss counters in the final trace.
perfetto.conclusion: The two final traces consistently contain fewer Compose:recompose slices during presentation (57-58 versus 94); summed recompose duration is modestly lower but varies between final runs. Initial AndroidOwner measurement remains about 31.5-32.9ms and the Popup-to-Dialog gap is unchanged. This is a targeted reduction in repeated presentation work, not proof of faster first visibility or a stable app-wide performance gain.
perfetto.traceCapture: One interaction per trace; no screen recording, screenshots, or instrumentation ran concurrently.

failuresPreserved: The first two attempts stopped at the device lock screen/initial notification prompt before any dialog sample; no measurements were taken from those attempts.

An initial trace query used the historical directory and a follow-up query had a fixed prior-run timestamp; both queries failed/returned no result. The trace was retained and reprocessed from the correct directory using the MainActivity FrameTimeline start.
One combined Debug and PerformanceBenchmark build attempt exposed a missing background import; the import was restored and the full final build passed.
